first_launch: systemd default working directory could not locate relative source; no fit started. Journal preserved in spline_direct_ks_launch_failure.log.
retry: Explicit working directory fixed execution. systemd expanded braced f in the log filename, causing the five sequential stdout lines to share one log. All five models, predictions, optimizer diagnostics, completion records and their hashes were retained.
limitation: First four one-line stdout completion messages were overwritten; their information survives in the corresponding complete.json, not as recovered raw stdout.
future_launcher_rule: Use a Python launcher or systemd-run --expand-environment=no with a fixed working directory.
